newsitem.title: USA: Keystone to buy Financial Trust.
newsitem.headline: Keystone to buy Financial Trust.

text.p: Keystone Financial Inc said Friday that it has definitively agreed to acquire Financial Trust Corp, a Pennsylvania bank holding company with about $1.2 billion in assets.

Under the agreement, each Financial Trust share would be converted into 1.65 shares of Keystone. Based on Thursday's $26.50 per share closing bid price of Keystone, the value per share of Financial Trust approximates $43.73 and totals $371 million.
Financial Trust shares surged 10-3/4 Friday morning to 40.
Keystone said the merger should be completed in the first half of 1997 and contribute to 1998 earnings per share growth.
Upon closing, Keystone expects to record a pre-tax charge of about $10 million.
Financial Trust Chief Executive Ray Wolfe will become Keystone's chairman and join its board with two other Financial Trust directors, the company said.
Keystone said that after the merger and the previously announced acquisition of First Financial Corp of Western Maryland, its assets will increase 30 percent to about $6.7 billion.
